entries.review_method: Traced Kalipo and Hunting Dept. 2 Manager branches, the shared que_dic helper, the quest record timer, and required item definition.
entries.title: Kalipo request eligibility and repeat cycle
conditions: Kalipo checks weight capacity, requires the Ring of the Ancient Wise King (item 2782) to be equipped, requires ep13_3_invite to be at least 6, and requires Base Level 100 or higher.

A player can hold only one active Kalipo request record at a time. While quest record 12160 is active, Kalipo will not offer another request; the player must report the current request to the Hunting Dept. 2 Manager.

Quest record 12160 has a configured 82,800 second time limit (23 hours). After it expires, the player must speak with the Hunting Dept. 2 Manager, who clears any remaining request records, then return to Kalipo.
Kalipo selects among six requests with a Base-Level-dependent random value and threshold branches; the six offers are not equal-probability choices.

required_source_literals: Name: "Ring of the Ancient Wise King"

entries.review_method: Traced Laponte's offer branch and Hunting Dept. 1 Manager's turn-in branch, both calling the shared que_dic helper (function defined at quests_dicastes.txt:474), and cross-checked the reward table against the literal que_dic(0,...) call sites.
entries.title: Laponte hunting-request eligibility, reward table, and repeat cycle
conditions: Laponte#pa0829 (dicastes01,187,230,5) requires the Ring of the Ancient Wise King (item 2782) equipped, ep13_3_invite at least 6, and Base Level 97 or higher before offering a request.
A player can hold only one active Laponte request record (quest 12159) at a time; while it is in progress but not yet turned in, Laponte declines to offer another.

Laponte selects among the seven requests (12099-12105) with a Base-Level-weighted random value (rand(97,BaseLevel)) and ascending threshold branches, so the seven offers are not equal-probability choices; higher Base Level favors the later, higher-reward requests.

Hunting Dept. 1 Manager (dic_in01,48,263,5) requires the same ring/invite gate and Base Level 97 or higher, and turns in the active request via the shared que_dic(0, quest_id, base_exp, message) call.
que_dic mode 0 only completes and rewards a request once its Hercules HUNTING objective is satisfied (questprogress(quest_id, HUNTING) == 2); otherwise it silently returns without reward.

On success que_dic's shared tail grants the request's base EXP (0 job EXP), completes and erases the quest record, and always grants one Sapha Certification (item 6304) regardless of which of the seven requests was active.

Quest record 12159 has a configured 82,800 second (23 hour) time limit; Hunting Dept. 1 Manager's PLAYTIME==2 branch calls que_dic(2, ...) to clear any expired remaining request record, matching the already-reviewed 12160/Kalipo cycle's expiry behavior.

entries.review_method: Traced all four offering NPCs (Pura, Tragis, Calyon, Moltuka) and their matching turn-in managers (Supply Dept. 1/2, Transport Dept. 1/2), all of which call the same que_dic helper (function defined at quests_dicastes.txt:474) in its item-delivery mode (mode 1), and cross-checked each request's required item/quantity/EXP against its literal que_dic(1,...) call.
entries.title: Pura, Tragis, Calyon, and Moltuka item-delivery requests (Supply/Transport Depts.)
conditions: Each of the four offering NPCs requires the Ring of the Ancient Wise King (item 2782) equipped, ep13_3_invite at least 6, and Base Level 80 or higher: Pura#pa0829 (dicastes01,208,230,3) for the 10 requests 12117-12126 (record 12161), Tragis#pa0829 (dicastes01,225,211,3) for the 10 requests 12127-12136 (record 12162), Calyon#pa8029 (dicastes01,223,190,1) for the 11 requests 12137-12147 (record 12163), and Moltuka#pa0829 (dicastes01,211,178,2) for the 11 requests 12148-12158 (record 12164).

Each offering NPC selects one request uniformly at random from its own list (rand(1,N)) and sets both the specific request quest and its shared record quest (12161/12162/12163/12164); a player can hold only one active record per NPC at a time.

Each request's matching manager (Supply Dept. 1 Manager at dic_in01,51,270,7 for 12161; Supply Dept. 2 Manager at dic_in01,48,273,1 for 12162; Transport Dept. 1 Mgr at dic_in01,43,273,1 for 12163; Transport Dept. 2 Mgr at dic_in01,40,270,2 for 12164) requires the same ring/invite/Base-Level-80 gate.

que_dic mode 1 (getarg(0)==1) requires the record quest to still be active, then checks countitem(item_id) against the request's required quantity; if short, it stops without granting anything or consuming items.

On success que_dic mode 1 consumes the required item quantity via delitem, then falls through to the shared tail: grants the request's base EXP (0 job EXP), completes and erases the quest record, and always grants one Sapha Certification (item 6304), the same universal ticket item used by the hunting-mode requests.

All four record quests (12161, 12162, 12163, 12164) have a configured 82,800 second (23 hour) time limit; each manager's PLAYTIME==2 branch calls que_dic(2, ...) to clear an expired remaining request record before the NPC will offer or process a new one.

The reward table (per-request item ID, required quantity, and base EXP) is read directly from each manager's literal que_dic(1, quest_id, exp, item_id, qty, message) call and is cited in full in the source lines below.

entries.review_method: Traced all six near-identical delivery branches (Pedro the Sailor, Old Man Nardo, Blacksmith Pandoi, Collection Dealer Woeon, Talah, and Romel), each gated behind its own prerequisite quest and consuming one Soul Protection, converging on the same follow-on quest once all six are delivered.
entries.title: Malaya Spiritual Protection deliveries (six sailors/villagers)
conditions: Each of the six NPCs requires quest 7374 (an unreviewed umbrella quest) in progress plus its own specific prerequisite quest complete before offering the delivery option: Pedro the Sailor (malaya,326,68,2) needs 7368, Old Man Nardo (malaya,181,353,5) needs 7369, Blacksmith Pandoi (malaya,119,217,3) needs 7370, Collection Dealer Woeon (malaya,295,171,3) needs 7371, Talah (malaya,223,267,5) needs 7372, and Romel (malaya,224,267,3) needs 7373.
Each branch requires at least one Soul Protection in inventory; without one the NPC states its current protection still works and stops.

On success each NPC consumes one Soul Protection, erases its own prerequisite quest, and sets its corresponding delivery quest (7368->7382, 7369->7383, 7370->7384, 7371->7385, 7372->7386, 7373->7387).

After each individual delivery, the script sums questprogress across all six of 7382-7387; once all six are present (sum > 5) it sets quest 7379 (unreviewed follow-on) and erases all six delivery quest records in the same branch, regardless of which NPC was visited last.

entries.title: Eden Group Experts examination journey (Siege, Party, Battleground, Memorial Dungeon, Map)
entries.review_method: Traced Tutorial Goal and all five expert NPC declarations, dialogue progression, quiz question validation, and sequential setquest/completequest state transitions.
conditions: Initiated by Tutorial Goal at moc_para01 (32,179); requires a non-Novice first, second, or third class character (Class != Job_Novice).
Each expert requires passing a 3-question multiple-choice quiz about core game systems before completing their respective stage and advancing to the next expert.
Stage 1 (4161): Siege Master at moc_para01 (24,175) covers War of Emperium castle ownership, schedule, and economy investment.
Stage 2 (4162): Party Recruiting Expert at moc_para01 (21,172) covers party creation, recruitment window, and booking.
Stage 3 (4163): Battleground Master at moc_para01 (12,179) covers battleground queueing, emblems, and Maroll officers.
Stage 4 (4164): Memorial Dungeon Expert at moc_para01 (28,167) covers instance creation, party leader role, and reservation limits.
Stage 5 (4165): Map Expert at moc_para01 (14,168) covers map coordinates, world map view, and navigation.
Passing all five stages sets quest 4166 (Passing Grades), whose final turn-in reward is reviewed separately.

entries.title: Tutorial Instructor feature training flow (Mercenary, Quest Window, Catalog, Return, Cooldown)
entries.review_method: Traced Tutorial Instructor NPC dialogue branches, mercenary condition check, text input verification, catalog inventory checks, lent item turn-in, and 24-hour repeat timer.
conditions: Initiated by Tutorial Instructor at moc_para01 (34,178); requires a non-Novice character (Class != Job_Novice).
Stage 1 (9167): Player must hire a mercenary from the Mercenary Guild in Prontera. Instructor checks getmercinfo(MERCINFO_CLASS) != 0 before completing 9167.
Stage 2 (9168): Player is prompted to consult the Quest Window for the item request and must type '10 Jellopy' exactly to pass the test.
Stage 3 (9169): Player must obtain a Universal Silver Catalog (Vending_Search_Scroll) from the Catalogue Wizard in South Prontera.
Stage 4 (9170): Player must use the Universal Silver Catalog; having zero remaining in inventory completes this stage.
Intermediary stage 9171 (trading 10 Jellopy for lent demonstration items) is reviewed separately under eden_tutorial_instructor_enchant_9171.

Stage 5 (9172): Player inspects the lent mantle items and returns them; the script removes Tutorial Mantle (15033 x2, 15034 x1), completes 9172, awards 5,000 Base EXP and 2,500 Job EXP, and sets cooldown quest 9173.
Stage 6 (9173): A 24-hour cooldown timer (86,400 seconds) during which the instructor offers Q&A lore. After 24 hours expire, the player may repeat the tutorial sequence.
